These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0005] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Annotate Decimal-returning functions: Functions in ledgerly/invoice.py that return money values are annotated with `-> Decimal`; keep that annotation when implementing stubs.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0002] Convert unit prices with to_money before storing: Always normalize monetary inputs through `to_money` from `ledgerly.money` before storing them on models; it rejects floats with a `float_amount` BillingError and returns a Decimal. Compare against `ZERO` from `ledgerly.money` rather than constructing Decimal literals.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Signal domain failures by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with stable snake_case codes such as `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity` and `negative_amount`, matching the existing `issue_invoice` pattern.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 3x, 1 passed, 2 failed)
